$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKD (AIP France, chart dated 2025-09-04): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Sollières-Sardières

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for pilots complying with one of the following conditions: based or based on neighbouring AD (see 1) and authorized by an instructor (or holding an instructor's licence),; holding a licence for mountain flights.
AD available for HEL and ULM.
For ULM pilots, it is advised to have followed the mountain course organized by the FFPLUM.

Particular aerological conditions, especially in case of wind from East / South-East sector (Lombarde) causing strong downdrafts.The use of the airfield is strongly not recommended with these wind conditions.
Entering in the circuit after overhead AD at 5700 ft AMSL (1400 ft AAL).
In light winds, prefer RWY 19 for TKOF and RWY 01 for LDG given the environment and the RWY slope.
TKOF RWY 19: as soon as possible, turn 30° to the right to go along the relief and avoid flying over hamlet of Chatel and Bramans and Verney villages.
TKOF RWY 01: as soon as possible, turn 25° to the right to avoid flying of Sollières village.
AEM (NR 9875): see AIP ENR 5.5 (1) AD voisins / Neighbouring AD:

AD réservé aux pilotes répondant à l'une des conditions suivantes : basés ou basés sur les AD voisins (voir 1) et autorisés par un instructeur (ou possédant la qualification instructeur) ; titulaire de la qualification montagne.
AD utilisable par HEL et ULM.
Pour les pilotes d'ULM, il est conseillé d'avoir suivi le cursus montagne organisé par la FFPULM.

Conditions aérologiques très particulières, notamment en cas de vent de secteur Est / Sud-Est (Lombarde) entraînant de forts rabattants. L'utilisation de la plateforme est vivement déconseillée dans ces conditions de vent.
Entrée dans le circuit après verticale AD à 5700 ft AMSL (1400 ft AAL).
Par vent faible, préférer un décollage en RWY 19 et un atterrissage en RWY 01 compte tenu de l'environnement et de la pente de la piste.
Décollage RWY 19 : dès que possible, altérer sa route de 30° vers la droite pour longer le relief et éviter le survol du hameau du Chatel et des villages de Bramans et du Verney.
Décollage RWY 01 : dès que possible, altérer sa route de 25° vers la droite pour éviter le survol du village de Sollières.
